messages:
Noelle (sales): Quick sync: HelioWorks wants a 30-day eval. PO HW-2026 attached. They included an escrow paragraph, Net45, and a requirement to list Redwood as 'supplier of record' for tax purposes. Need legal + finance review before I send a redline. SQ: https://sq.vendor/helioworks-poc

Ibrahim (legal): Paste the escrow and tax lines please. Also confirm whether they want to deviate our MSA.

Noelle (sales): Escrow: "Supplier to deposit source with escrow agent; release on insolvency or at buyer discretion after 60 days." Tax: "Buyer will withhold taxes and is not responsible for gross-up. Supplier to bear tax cost." They attached PO only; no MSA changes noted.

Ravi (solutions): For the POC we provide a shared sandbox, estimate $9k. No dedicated infra. Source escrow is excessive. We can provide compiled artifacts and a runbook.

Ibrahim (legal): Proposed redline: limit escrow to distributable binaries, deployment scripts that are necessary to run the product, and operator runbooks. Remove buyer discretion for release  releases only on insolvency, breach of support obligations, or prolonged service discontinuation after a 90-day cure period. Require a three-way escrow agreement naming agent and jurisdiction.

Clare (finance): Net45 for a $9k POC conflicts with our default Net30 for trials. Net45 needs director signoff; increases AR risk. Also need to confirm payment method (ACH/wire).

Jin (AE): Buyer insists on Net45 for their internal cadence. They prefer DocuSign parallel signers to speed execution (Procurement + Legal). Can we do that?

Ibrahim (legal): We can accept parallel signature flows but legal must pre-approve the redline before envelope goes live. Also, push back on the 'buyer discretion' release and the supplier tax burden. Proposed tax language: "Buyer may withhold taxes as required by law and will provide documentation; withholding will be applied only as required by law."

Ravi (solutions): Also explicitly exclude private keys, CI credentials, and internal monitoring dashboards from any escrow deliverables. If buyer presses for source code, escalate.

Noelle (sales): I'll send redline back: narrow escrow scope, change release triggers, adjust tax wording, request Net30 or prepay. Copying procurement contact (Elena).

DocuSign Bot: Draft envelope 3111111135 created (HelioWorks-PO HW-2026). Status: draft, awaiting attachments (annotated PO).

Clare (finance): If they accept Net30, green. If they insist on Net45, I'll request manager approval and flag collector impact.

Ibrahim (legal): Once buyer responds, I'll attach annotated PO. Do not accept any clause that expands indemnity to their subcontractors without review.

Noelle (sales): Thanks all. Will update thread with buyer reply and SQ answers. :ok_hand:
